Harrasment/Obnoxious/Attitude

He has been abusing powers as a leader in teams, calling others out, etc. I really don't know how to explain this in typing format. A call on skype would help so maybe I could show you guys.

Abuse of powers/fake leaving threads/Ban evasion

I would just like you guys to understand he has been also with acceqted in this but he has been making fake leaving threads which is annoying. He has also been ban evading on many accounts. Please do something. Again, I feel bad so I don't want to say a punishment but anything you guys can do will help. 


Thanks for helping!
